summaries.ja: 若葉を上半分の6列2段の12の区画へ、1枚ずつ別の区画に散らす。枚数を書けばその枚数（1〜12枚）、書かなければ4〜6枚。各葉は両端で触れる二つの小さな弧で、鉛筆の緑、細かな揺れ、縦を中心に左右へ少し傾いて上を向く。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: Scatter young leaves over twelve cells of the upper half, six columns by two rows, one leaf per cell: the written count (1–12), or 4–6 when none is written. Each is two small pencil-green arcs touching at both ends, narrowly swaying, pointing upward mostly upright with a slight lean either way. Fill each leaf interior with the same color as its outline.

summaries.ja: 下端の1〜2箇所の同じ根元から、菖蒲の剣のような長く細い葉を、ほぼ平行に少し開いて上へ並べる。本数を書けばその本数（1〜10本、左の根元に4本まで、次に右）、書かなければ3・4・6・8・10本。丈は葉ごとに違え、細筆の緑で描き、地面は描かない。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: From one or two shared root spots at the bottom edge, raise long slim sword-like blades, nearly parallel and slightly spread: the written count (1–10, up to four on the left root, then the right), or 3, 4, 6, 8, or 10 when none is written. Heights differ per blade; drawn in fine-brush green, no ground. Fill each blade interior with the same color as its outline.

summaries.ja: 中域の水平な灰の太筆枝をゆるやかに波打たせ、その上に青葉を上下交互に、枝先の方へ斜めに出す。枚数を書けばその枚数（1〜12枚）、書かなければ6〜8枚を、枝の12の付け位置へ散らす。葉は根元側ほど大きく枝先ほど小さく、両端で触れる二弧を細筆の緑で描き、内側も同じ緑で塗る。
summaries.en: Draw one horizontal gray thick-brush branch loosely undulating through the middle, and grow summer leaves from it alternately above and below, slanting toward the tip: the written count (1–12), or 6–8 when none is written, spread over twelve points along the branch. Leaves are largest at the base and smaller toward the tip; each is two fine-brush green arcs touching at both ends, filled with the same green.

summaries.ja: 中域の掌の中心から、紅葉の葉5枚または7枚を上半分へ扇形に並べる。中央の葉が最も長く、左右ほど短く、7枚のときは下に小さな葉2枚を加える。各葉は両端で触れる二弧を赤のロットリングで描き、中心から下へ茎を引く。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: From a palm center in the middle, fan 5 or 7 maple lobes over the upper half. The middle lobe is longest and the side lobes shorter; with 7, two small lobes point below. Each is two red rotring arcs touching at both ends, with a stem drawn down from the center. Fill each lobe with the same color as its outline.

summaries.ja: 落葉を左上から右下へ流れる斜めの帯に、流れの左右へ大きく不揃いに散らし、下ほど密に集める。枚数を書けばその枚数（1〜16枚）、書かなければ8〜12枚。各葉は両端で触れる二弧で、クレヨンの赤と灰を交互にし、傾きをばらし、縁ににじみを加える。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: Scatter fallen leaves widely and unevenly to both sides of a drift from upper left to lower right, gathering more densely toward the bottom: the written count (1–16), or 8–12 when none is written. Each is a bleeding crayon two-arc form touching at both ends, alternating red and gray with varied rotations. Fill each leaf interior with the same color as its outline.

summaries.ja: 下端の1〜2箇所の同じ根元から、枯れた長い葉を上へ並べる。本数を書けばその本数（1〜10本、左の根元に4本まで、次に右）、書かなければ3・4・6・8・10本。丈を葉ごとに変え、傾きを垂直から右へ倒れるまで大きく違え、チョークの灰で小刻みに揺らし、縁ににじみを加え、地面は描かない。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: From one or two shared root spots at the bottom edge, raise long withered blades: the written count (1–10, up to four on the left root, then the right), or 3, 4, 6, 8, or 10 when none is written. Heights differ per blade and the lean ranges widely from upright to lying toward the right, in tightly swaying gray chalk with bleeding edges and no ground. Fill each blade interior with the same color as its outline.

summaries.ja: 縮れた枯葉を下の左右の隅の8つの区画へ、1枚ずつ別の区画に置く。枚数を書けばその枚数（1〜8枚）、書かなければ2〜4枚。各葉は両端で触れる深い弧と浅い弧で、チョークの灰と黄を交互にし、縁を細かく揺らし、傾きをばらす。各葉の内側を輪郭と同じ色で塗る。
summaries.en: Place curled withered leaves in eight cells of the lower left and right corners, one leaf per cell: the written count (1–8), or 2–4 when none is written. Each is a deep arc and a shallow arc touching at both ends, alternating gray and yellow chalk, with narrowly swaying edges and varied rotations. Fill each leaf interior with the same color as its outline.
